kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
تفاءلت (form VI)
# تَفَاءَلْتُ (tafāʔaltu) /ta.faː.ʔal.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَفَاءَلَ (tafāʔala)
# تَفَاءَلْتَ (tafāʔalta) /ta.faː.ʔal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَفَاءَلَ (tafāʔala)
# تَفَاءَلْتِ (tafāʔalti) /ta.faː.ʔal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَفَاءَلَ (tafāʔala)
# تَفَاءَلَتْ (tafāʔalat) /ta.faː.ʔa.lat/: third-person fem
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
